tools.name: getFileContents
tools.description: Retrieve the contents of a specific note, document, or file from your Obsidian vault stored in GitHub (/). Perfect for accessing your knowledge base content.

filePath.description: Path to the file within the repository.

tools.name: searchFiles
tools.description: Search for notes, documents, and files within your Obsidian vault on GitHub (/). Find specific knowledge base content using GitHub's powerful search syntax. Supports searching in filenames, paths, and content.

query.description: Search query - can be a simple term or use GitHub search qualifiers

searchIn.description: Where to search: 'filename' (exact filename match), 'path' (anywhere in file path), 'content' (file contents), or 'all' (comprehensive search)

tools.name: searchIssues
tools.description: Search for issues and discussions in your Obsidian vault repository (/). Great for tracking tasks, project management, and collaborative knowledge work.

query.description: Search query (uses GitHub Issue Search syntax)

tools.name: getCommitHistory
tools.description: Track the evolution of your Obsidian vault knowledge base by retrieving commit history from GitHub (/). See how your notes and ideas have developed over time with detailed diffs.

days.description: Number of days to look back for commits

includeDiffs.description: Whether to include actual file changes/diffs (default: true)

maxCommits.description: Maximum number of commits to return

tools.name: diagnoseSearch
tools.description: Diagnose search functionality and repository configuration for your Obsidian vault on GitHub (/). Verifies repository connectivity, search capabilities, and checks if repository size is within GitHub's indexing limits.
